content.text: h07. **Request path:** the browser hits `GET /file/users/{username}/avatar` — that URL is minted server-side in `convertUserFromStore`, which replaces the stored base64 data URI with `/file/{userpb.Name}/avatar` so the JSON payload stays small; the React `` just renders it. Hops from the HTTP request to stored data: ``` UserAvatar () — web/src/components/UserAvatar.tsx:12 FileServerService.RegisterRoutes — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:121 (GET /file/users/:identifier/avatar → serveUserAvatar, line 124) FileServerService.serveUserAvatar — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:168 FileServerService.getUserByUsername — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:711 (store.FindUser{Username: &identifier}) Store.GetUser — store/user.go:148 (userCache checked only when find.ID is set; a username lookup always falls through) Store.ListUsers — store/user.go:136 (delegates to s.driver, populates userCache) Driver.ListUsers (interface) — store/driver.go:47 DB.ListUsers — store/db/sqlite/user.go:88 (SELECT ... avatar_url ... FROM user WHERE username = ?; siblings: store/db/postgres/user.go, store/db/mysql/user.go) ``` Then back in the handler, the bytes come out of the row itself, not a blob store: `user.AvatarURL` holds a `data:;base64,...` URI, which `parseDataURI` (server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:735) splits with `dataURIRegex` (line 93) and base64-decodes. The MIME type is checked against `avatarAllowedTypes` (line 72), then served via `c.Blob` with `Cache-Control: public, max-age=3600` and the `setSecurityHeaders` CSP. Two things worth noting for the "another user's" part of the question: - There is no per-user authorization check on this route — any avatar is readable by any caller once the instance gate passes. The only gate is at fileserver.go:172: if `!s.Profile.AllowAnonymous()` (a private instance with no InstanceURL), the request must authenticate via `getCurrentUser` → `authenticator.AuthenticateToUser` (server/auth) using a Bearer token/PAT or refresh-token cookie. On a public instance, avatars are anonymous-readable. - The `:identifier` param is matched against username only, not user ID (fileserver.go:711).
